messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR #9123 needs a quick pair review + merge-watch before today's cutoff (20:00 UTC). It's the KV-cache OOM guardrail change; low-risk but touches eviction logic. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9123
Priya: I can take merge-watch from 19:30–20:30 UTC if someone can do the second reviewer for the eviction logic. @Alex can you paste the short smoke checklist? :thumbsup:
Alex: sure — smoke checklist:
```
- run `./bin/smoke --kvcache` on staging
- verify no regression in eviction latency (at most +5ms)
- run `integration/oom_sim.sh` quick run
- sanity-check traces in /traces/kv-evict
```
Sam: quick look at the diff — looks clean. main question: did we keep previous TTL semantics? small comment on line 84.
Alex: yes TTL retained, added extra null-check. pushed fix for your comment.
Marta: CI is flaking on `eviction_integration_test` right now — I retriggered. I'd prefer a second human review on the concurrency bits before we ship, given the flake.
Priya: I can be the second reviewer. I'll wait for CI green and then run the smoke steps. Ping me when CI passes.
CI Bot: build #5921 for PR 9123 — rerun started by Marta.
CI Bot: build #5921 — all checks passed.
Priya: CI looks good. Running quick smoke now.
Priya: smoke pass ✅ — eviction latency within baseline, oom sim behaved as expected. Posting logs: https://logs.internal/9123/smoke
Priya: LGTM from me after smoke. @Marta you still good with concurrency changes?
Marta: looked through the concurrency section; small nits but nothing blocking. LGTM. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Approved. :thumbsup:
Alex: Awesome — thanks all. I'll merge after the rollout window opens at 19:58 UTC and I'll be on merge-watch until 20:20 UTC. Please shout here if you see any post-merge regressions.
Priya: I'll keep an eye on error-rate dashboards 19:59–20:30 UTC.
Marta: will monitor traces.
CI Bot: deploy to staging initiated by Alex at 19:59 UTC.
Alex: merged and cutting the canary. Will report back in 10m with initial telemetry.
